Container.Name: kb-redis
Container.Overview: Redis for the knowledge stack's model router - the provider spend counters and the response cache kb-litellm keeps here. STARTED IN ORDER: kb-postgres, then kb-redis, then kb-litellm, then kb-service, then kb-webui. There is no template equivalent of compose depends_on, so nothing enforces that for you; kb-litellm needs this one up for its budgets. NETWORK: the kb containers share one user-defined Docker network named kb that you create once, by hand, before the first start (a template cannot create a network, so Network stays bridge here - set it to kb when you create the container). On that network this container is reachable by its container name, kb-redis, on port 6379. Docker must preserve user-defined networks across updates (Unraid: Settings > Docker, Preserve user defined networks = Yes), or the containers fall back to bridge and that name stops resolving. EXPOSURE: this template publishes no host port, so Redis is reachable only from a container on the kb network. PASSWORD: set the REDIS_PASSWORD Variable and give the same value to kb-litellm. It is not written into Post Arguments or Extra Parameters: Post Arguments is a small sh wrapper that reads the Variable inside the container and refuses to start without it. Leave Post Arguments as shipped and leave Tailscale off for this container. STORAGE: Redis runs with append-only persistence and the spend counters live in the Data mount, so set it to a path on a pool and put it under backup; losing it resets the counts the spend caps are measured against. IMAGE TAG: redis:7.4-alpine follows the 7.4 patch releases, so an Update takes security fixes but never a new minor version.
Container.PostArgs: sh -c 'test -n "$REDIS_PASSWORD" || { echo "kb-redis: REDIS_PASSWORD is empty, refusing to start"; exit 1; }; exec docker-entrypoint.sh redis-server --requirepass "$REDIS_PASSWORD" --appendonly yes'
Container.Description: Redis for the model router's budgets and cache. Start after kb-postgres, before kb-litellm. Password-protected; publishes no host port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: REQUIRED. The append-only file; the model router's spend counters live here. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kb-redis/data. Put it under backup. The official Redis image sets the ownership of this directory itself before dropping privileges.

Config.Name: REDIS_PASSWORD
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Password clients must give. Use a long random value and give the same one to kb-litellm. The container refuses to start when this is empty.
